source_title: Enterprise SSD Market Sees Strong 3Q24 Growth, Revenue Soars 28.6% on Surging Demand for High-Capacity Models, Says TrendForce

claim_relevant_segments.procurement_volume_qoq: total procurement volume for enterprise SSDs rose 15% compared to the previous quarter
claim_relevant_segments.industry_revenue_qoq: overall industry revenue up by an impressive 28.6% QoQ

researcher_paraphrase: TrendForce reported 3Q24 enterprise SSD procurement volume up 15% QoQ and industry revenue up 28.6% QoQ.
precision_guard: These are 3Q24 market observations, not a full-year 2024 exabyte or unit total. Procurement-volume growth and revenue growth are distinct metrics and must not be converted into each other.
authority_boundary: TrendForce is methodological-primary for its own measured market series and scope; underlying supplier transactions are not independently reproduced here.
